-- Smoke test for the wasm32-built Mathlib bundle.
-- This is the full library: 7,515 / 7,516 modules cross-compiled to
-- wasm32 (only the root `Mathlib` umbrella module is omitted — importing
-- everything at once exceeds the 4 GB wasm32 address space). The oleans
-- ship as ~500 MB shards (oleans.bundle.NNN + oleans.bundle.manifest.json)
-- rather than one file, so each shard stays under Cloudflare's 512 MB
-- free-tier cache cap.
--
-- NOTE: staging all ~4 GB of oleans into a single wasm32 MEMFS instance
-- hits the same 4 GB ceiling. In practice import the specific submodules
-- your file needs, not the whole library.

import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Defs

#check @Real.instField
#check @Monoid
